dims_mm.note: Acer lists 292 x 112.7-123 x 28.5-48.4 mm. h uses the maximum (123 mm); d is the body, d_max the grips.

weight_g.note: Acer: under 750 g with the 80 Wh battery, under 700 g with the 60 Wh battery. The battery fitted to Arc G3 SKUs is not published.

slots.note: One M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 NVMe slot

ports.note: Acer: dual Thunderbolt 4 for docking, display output and accessories

screen.note: IPS-level, 16:9, 100% sRGB, Gorilla Glass Victus with DXC, 10-point touch. Tempered-glass protector in the box.

battery.note: Acer lists up to 80 Wh with a 60 Wh option on select models and does not map battery to SoC for the Atlas 7. On the Atlas 8, Arc G3 SKUs have 60 Wh. 4S1P 4-cell Li-ion. 65 W USB-C adapter.

controls.stick_note: Acer spec: "L and R full-size analog joysticks (Carbon Film) or L and R full-size TMR joysticks". TMR is "available on select models"; Acer does not say which SoC SKUs get TMR.
controls.note: The Atlas 7 control list omits the adjustable trigger switches that the Atlas 8 lists, so trigger_lock is false. Rear L/R macro buttons.

cooling: dual fan (one metal Predator AeroBlade fan, one plastic fan)
notes: Base Arc G3 SKUs of the Predator Atlas 7 (announced at IFA 2026; North America Q4 2026, EMEA November 2026). No SKU list, price or battery mapping published. Chassis, ports, screen and controls are shared with acer-predator-atlas-7 (Arc G3 Extreme).
